evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Safely enable parallel execution of existing Go tests without changing test behavior.
intent.acceptance: Observed partial facet: the same top-level Test name, file, package, build constraints and unchanged body gain a direct leading call on the actual testing.T parameter; exclude generated files and directly detected os/testing process-state mutations. Race safety, fixed-resource isolation, package-global behavior and full-suite acceptance are separate and not inferred.

evidence.opportunity: Existing top-level testing.T tests in tracked, non-generated Go test files, excluding vendor, testdata and node_modules.
filters: Added, deleted or renamed test identities are not parallelization deliveries.
Compare each mainline change with its immutable first parent; retain signed withdrawals.
Count demonstrated source changes, not full race-safe acceptance, faster execution, PR counts or exclusive workflow causation.
Direct-marker and independently graph-linked downstream PRs are corroborated contributions, not safe-output creation receipts.
evidence.collection: Replay the retained immutable Go blob feature table and normalized GitHub linkage archive once per batch; no network calls during scoring.

model.architecture: A Go standard-library AST oracle verifies the native source facet; Git first-parent deltas identify deliveries and normalized GitHub graph identities identify shared contributions.
model.recommendation: Review delivery changes separately from race/full-suite evidence; no keep bar or cost claim is inferred.

metrics.name: Repository net unchanged-body parallel activations
metrics.formula: qualifying leading parallel activations minus qualifying withdrawals in the non-overlapping period

metrics.name: Corroborated workflow-linked net parallel activations
metrics.formula: the same native signed effects restricted to immutable merge revisions linked to this workflow
